title: Donation at Anand Niketan
summary: As part of an ongoing community service initiative, 70 sholapur sheets (bedsheets) were distributed to residents at the Anand Niketan / King George V Old Age Home.
description: As part of an ongoing community service initiative, 70 sholapur sheets (bedsheets) were distributed to residents at the Anand Niketan / King George V Old Age Home. The initiative aimed to provide warmth and comfort to the elderly residents, many of whom rely on such support for their daily well-being. This gesture reflects a continued commitment to the welfare of the elderly and underserved communities, reinforcing the values of care, dignity, and service that these outreach efforts stand for.
location: Anand Niketan - King George 5, Mumbai, Maharashtra
